intersection_boundary: Four exact source helper call sites execute in original ARM; their output words feed the host body. The host has not reconstructed the three-plane intersection arithmetic itself.
import_boundary: The original helper instructions run in Unicorn, while imported floating arithmetic, sqrt, conversion, and comparison routines are modeled IEEE operations; imported-library details and NaN payload propagation are excluded.
comparison_boundary: Strict ordered binary32 greater/less semantics match the observed __aeabi_fcmpgt and __aeabi_fcmplt calls.

function.scope: Complete four-corner bounds writer; each source plane-intersection return is ignored, and each output vector starts at zero.

supporting_functions.scope: Executed by original ARM as the explicit host-service boundary; the port does not implement it.
Supporting body of the three-plane intersection boundary, executed by original ARM only.
